case.title: Density changes Tech View rows only, not Board View cards or List
case.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technician {Technician-A} is active at {Location-A}, with Time Clock on and a Role other than "Office User" or "Time Clock User".
    For example: {Technician-A} is Esther Howard.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has one Approved work order, {Work-order-1}, led by {Technician-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Scope and {Work-order-1} is S1-702.
  • In Tech View the density is "Regular", and a second browser tab shows the "Customers" page, opened before you start.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "List" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
case.custom_steps:
1. Look at the height of {Work-order-1}'s row.
  2. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  3. Look at the toolbar and at the space around the card of {Work-order-1}.
  4. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  5. Click the density button and choose "Comfortable".
  6. Click the density button and choose "Compact".
  7. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  8. Click "List" in the display switcher.
  9. Switch to the "Customers" browser tab and reload the page.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: List shows {Work-order-1}'s row at its usual height.
  • Step 2: Board View shows the card of {Work-order-1} in {Technician-A}'s column.
  • Step 3: Board View's toolbar has no density button.
  • Step 4: Tech View shows, with a density button in its toolbar.
  • Step 5: Tech View's rows become roomier (taller).
  • Step 6: Tech View's rows become tighter (shorter) than at Comfortable and at Regular.
  • Step 7: Board View still has no density button, and the card of {Work-order-1} has the same spacing as at step 3.
  • Step 8: {Work-order-1}'s row in List is the same height as at step 1.
  • Step 9: the Customers table's rows are the same height as before the reload.

Known problem (SV-11580, Open; planned for this release): until it ships, Board View still shows the density button and its cards follow the density chosen in Tech View. (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results say, mark it Passed and tell the QA lead: the change has shipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, stories SV-10049 (Story 6, Density in Tech View and Board View) and SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); ticket SV-11580

  • S6-E1: “Density applies to Tech View rows on Work Orders; Board View cards keep their current spacing in this release. List keeps today’s row size, and other application tables are unchanged.”
  • S3-R11: “Board View shows no Density control in this release (SV-11580). Column Selection sits centered between the toolbar’s two dividers, with no empty gap where Density was. A Card size control as in the design (Compact and Detailed) follows as a fast follow (SV-11581).”
  • S6-R3: “Density belongs to Tech View only. Board View’s fast-follow Card size (SV-11581) is saved separately.”
  • S6-R2: “Density adjusts spacing and the size of rows, cards, and their elements.”

Not yet checked against a build in this wording.

AUTOMATION: READY - EXPECT FAIL (SV-11580)

changes.new_value:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 1 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Esther Howard") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard".
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.

changes.new_value:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  4. At least 1 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A staff member is eligible when Time Clock is on, the staff member is active (not deactivated), the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field. To add one:
    • Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member, enter First Name and Last Name (e.g. "Esther Howard") and an email.
    • Pick a Role that is not Office User or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), pick at least one Department (required), set Location to this location and turn Time Clock on, then click Save & Close.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create the work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the case Customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its Asset > Save, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results) and click Save & Close.
    • Approve the line so the work order status reads Approved: turn on Line Approved in the New Line form before saving (or use the line's approve control on the Lines tab).
    • Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page and choose "Esther Howard". (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.)

changes.new_value:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • [Tech-A]: one eligible technician at this location. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Scope" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] led by [Tech-A].
  • Names are examples.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Scope" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Scope": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A].
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Scope" shows [WO-1] with Lead Technician [Tech-A]. If not, fix it on the work order page before starting; then clear the search.

changes.label: Steps

  2. Pick Tech View and set density to Comfortable, then Compact.

  5. Open another table in the app (e.g. Customers) and compare it with before.

1. Look at the height of {Work-order-1}'s row.
  2. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  3. Look at the toolbar and at the space around the card of {Work-order-1}.
  4. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  5. Click the density button and choose "Comfortable".
  6. Click the density button and choose "Compact".
  7. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  8. Click "List" in the display switcher.
  9. Switch to the "Customers" browser tab and reload the page.
